Extract IBSI-Standardized 3D Radiomics Features

Source: R/radiomics-ibsi.R
ai_extract_radiomics.Rd

Computes morphology, first-order intensity, 3D GLCM, 3D GLRLM, and 3D GLSZM features compliant with the Image Biomarker Standardisation Initiative (IBSI) Phase-1 specification.

Usage

ai_extract_radiomics(
  volume,
  mask = NULL,
  discretization = c("none", "fbn", "fbw"),
  n_bins = 16L,
  bin_width = 25,
  backend = c("native", "pyradiomics")
)

Arguments

volume

A 3D numeric array or a dicom_volume / list with $voxels and $spacing.

mask

Optional 3D binary/integer mask array (same dimensions as volume). If NULL, all non-NA voxels are included.

discretization

Intensity discretization: "none" (for integer phantoms), "fbn" (fixed bin number), or "fbw" (fixed bin width).

n_bins

Number of bins when discretization = "fbn" (default 16L).

bin_width

Bin width when discretization = "fbw" (default 25).

backend

Either "native" (pure R IBSI engine) or "pyradiomics".

Value

A tibble::tibble with columns family, feature, and value.

Examples

ph <- ibsi_digital_phantom()
rad <- ai_extract_radiomics(ph$volume, ph$mask, discretization = "none")
head(rad)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 3
#>   family      feature                value
#>   <chr>       <chr>                  <dbl>
#> 1 morphology  morph_voxel_volume  592     
#> 2 morphology  morph_surface_area  496     
#> 3 morphology  morph_sphericity      0.687 
#> 4 morphology  morph_compactness_1   0.0302
#> 5 first_order stat_mean             2.15  
#> 6 first_order stat_var              3.05
